subjectLine: Critical Cisco SD-WAN Zero-Day, CISA Orders VPN Patch, AI-Powered Cyberattacks & Worms

articles.title: Cisco SD-WAN Zero-Day Actively Exploited
articles.summary: Cisco has issued a warning about an unpatched zero-day vulnerability in its Catalyst SD-WAN Manager, which is being actively exploited in the wild. The flaw allows attackers to gain root privileges, posing a severe risk to network infrastructure management. Users are strongly advised to update their systems immediately, as no patch is currently available.

articles.title: CISA Orders US Agencies to Patch Check Point VPN Bug
articles.summary: CISA has given US government agencies three days to patch a critical vulnerability in Check Point's Remote Access VPN and Mobile Access deployments. The flaw is being exploited by Qilin ransomware affiliates in zero-day attacks. Prompt action is required to prevent further attacks.

articles.title: New Russia-Linked GREYVIBE Group Targets Ukraine with AI-Powered Cyberattacks
articles.summary: A new, previously undocumented threat actor named GREYVIBE, believed to be Russian-speaking and aligned with Kremlin interests, has been actively targeting Ukraine since August 2025. The group is employing AI-powered cyberattacks, indicating a sophisticated and persistent campaign.

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Authentication Bypass Vulnerability Under Active Exploitation
articles.summary: Palo Alto Networks has issued a warning about a medium-severity authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-0257) in PAN-OS and Prisma Access that is currently being actively exploited. Attackers can leverage this flaw to establish unauthorized VPN connections, potentially leading to network compromise.

articles.title: CISA Adds Exploited SolarWinds Serv-U DoS Flaw to KEV Catalog
articles.summary: CISA has added a critical denial-of-service vulnerability (CVE-2026-28318) in SolarWinds Serv-U software to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. The flaw is being actively exploited, making it imperative for organizations using the affected software to patch or mitigate the vulnerability immediately.

articles.title: HTTP/2 Bomb Vulnerability Causes Remote DoS on Major Web Servers
articles.summary: A newly discovered HTTP/2 vulnerability, dubbed 'HTTP/2 Bomb,' enables remote denial-of-service (DoS) attacks against major web servers like NGINX, Apache, IIS, Envoy, and Cloudflare. The vulnerability exploits default configurations, potentially disrupting critical online services.

articles.title: Miasma Worm Attacks 73 Microsoft GitHub Repositories
articles.summary: Microsoft's GitHub repositories have been compromised by the Miasma supply chain attack, impacting 73 repositories across several organizations including Azure and MicrosoftDocs. GitHub has disabled access to the affected repositories due to the self-replicating nature of the worm.

articles.title: Adaptive, Agentic AI Worms Predicted as Next Enterprise Threat
articles.summary: Researchers warn that adaptive and agentic AI worms, described as 'viruses with wings and brains,' pose a significant future threat to enterprises. These advanced malware variants are expected to emerge within the next year, capable of self-adaptation and autonomous propagation.

articles.title: AI Accelerates Vulnerability Exploitation, Threatening Traditional Management
articles.summary: The increasing speed of AI-driven vulnerability exploitation is drastically shrinking the window between disclosure and weaponization, making traditional vulnerability management strategies obsolete. Organizations must adapt to this new reality where threats can be weaponized within hours, necessitating a shift to proactive and automated defense mechanisms.

articles.title: One-Character Linux Kernel Flaw Enables Local Root Access, Exploits Now Public
articles.summary: A Linux kernel use-after-free vulnerability has been published, allowing an unprivileged local user to escalate to root and break out of a container. The flaw was patched upstream, but exploits are now publicly available. This vulnerability highlights the ongoing risks in the Linux kernel.

articles.title: Veeam Backup & Replication RCE Flaw Lets Domain Users Run Remote Code
articles.summary: A critical vulnerability was discovered in Veeam's Backup & Replication software, allowing remote code execution by authenticated domain users. This flaw has a CVSS score of 9.4 and highlights the importance of securing backup and replication systems to prevent potential attacks.

articles.title: Chrome V8 Zero-Day Exploited in the Wild
articles.summary: A zero-day vulnerability in Chrome's V8 engine is being actively exploited in the wild. Google has released a security update to address the issue, highlighting the importance of keeping software up to date to prevent exploitation of zero-day vulnerabilities.
